summary: Scoped as a focused follow-up to 20260814-fellowscript-marketing, addressing its two open questions on gatekeeper outreach: (1) whether Hallow's/YouVersion's institution-first parish-partnership tactics transfer to a smaller group-study product or whether a leader-first partnership shape is needed, and (2) whether campus-ministry-coalition partnerships are worth pursuing given small-team capacity and the documented caution that relational tactics outperform digital ones there. Research steps cover concrete outreach tactics, role-specific pitch angles (pastor / small-group leader / ministry coordinator / diocese-parish administrator), leader-first partnership analogs, campus-ministry specifics, a resource-realistic prioritized playbook, and post-adoption relationship-building. Mission, features, brand identity, channel selection, ASO, and referral mechanics are explicitly out of scope as already resolved upstream.
